title: Installment Terms
intro: Below are the requirements for arranging an installment plan, the general terms, and partner bank offers.

eligibility.title: Requirements for arranging an installment
eligibility.description: To arrange an installment plan, you must meet the following requirements:

items.citizen: Be a citizen of the Republic of Armenia
items.employment: Be a registered employee or have a clean credit history
items.documents: Have a passport, social card, or ID card
items.foreigners: Foreign citizens must provide a certificate from their place of registration
items.online: Online installment arrangement is also available from your preferred location without visiting the store

items.interest: 0–12% interest rate (depending on the chosen bank)
items.serviceFee: Account service fee — monthly from 1% of the total value, depending on the bank selected

partnerBanks.title: Partner banks
partnerBanks.description: Installments are available through the following partner banks. Terms may be changed by the bank.

disclaimer.title: Important note
disclaimer.description: Dear customer, please note that there may be certain differences between this estimate and the payment schedule approved by the bank at the time of in-store installment arrangement, depending on personal data.

items.nominalRate: Annual nominal interest rate — 21.6% per year without a service fee
items.commission: Loan commission — 0% monthly of the contractual loan amount
items.interestCalc: Interest calculation — daily on the declining loan balance

items.serviceFee: Commission — during loan servicing, a monthly account service fee of 0–1% of the loan balance is charged. In case of early repayment, it is reduced proportionally

items.age: Limit requests may be made by persons aged 18–70
items.term: Loan term via the “Installment on the spot” system — 12–36 months
items.latePenalty: Overdue obligations — a penalty of 0.13% of the overdue amount is charged for each day of delay

items.age: Limit requests may be made by men aged 20+ and women aged 18+
items.nominalRate: Nominal loan interest rate (depending on cooperation terms with the retail point) — 0%–21.4%
items.term: Loan term in months (depending on cooperation terms with the retail point) — 3–60 months
items.penalty: In case of non-performance, penalties on overdue loan and interest — 0.13% for each overdue calendar day

items.supervision: The bank is supervised by the Central Bank

items.borrower: Borrower — RA resident individuals aged 20+, whose age during loan servicing will not exceed 65
items.commission: Customer commission calculated monthly on the initial principal — 0%
